most_similar_reason: Candidate 6 shares the target's core plot almost point for point: a deity angered by human wickedness resolves to wipe out mankind with a deluge, a single forewarned righteous man builds and provisions a wooden vessel, he and his family alone survive, the waters recede, he offers thanks/sacrifice to the god upon landing, and his offspring become the ancestors of the peoples who repopulate the earth.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 5 is only a bare note that a creator figure with variant names is worshipped in a river region, containing no flood, no ark, no repopulation of humankind, and no narrative events at all to compare.
